fields.label: Enable Postings to ERPNext
fields.description: Perform queued ERPNext Outbox postings (Stock Entries, Job Card time logs, Work Order status changes). Off, postings queue up and wait.

fields.label: Pause the Outbox
fields.description: Keep queuing but perform nothing, for example during a stock reconciliation.

fields.label: Submit Job Cards When Complete
fields.description: Default for time-log postings that do not say: submit the Job Card once its completed quantity reaches the quantity it is for.

fields.label: Roll Up Machine Counts to Job Cards
fields.description: Every few minutes, and whenever a machine's current job changes, queue the machine's good and scrap counts and its running time since the last roll-up as time logs on the Job Card named by the machine's Current Job Reference.

fields.label: Inspect Job Cards from Machine Measurements
fields.description: Whenever a machine's current job changes, queue a Quality Inspection for the Job Card that ended from the machine's Measurement events while it ran, for the parameters of the Quality Inspection Template the card's operation (or BOM, or item) names. The readings are taken when the posting is performed. It is submitted only when every parameter of the template was measured; otherwise it is left as a draft to finish. A card without a template queues nothing.

fields.label: Wait for Late Measurements (minutes)
fields.description: How long after a job ends its inspection waits before the readings are taken, so measurements a gateway delivers late still count. 0 performs it on the next outbox run.

fields.label: Show Job Cards on the Floor
fields.description: Add the open Job Cards and Work Orders of each machine's workstation to the floor snapshot, and raise a suggestion for a machine running without one.

fields.label: Follow Job Cards Started in ERPNext
fields.description: When a Job Card goes Work In Progress in ERPNext (someone starts it there), make it the current job of every machine at its workstation that has no current job, from its first time log; when it is completed, cancelled or deleted, end it on the machines working on it, so their counts are rolled up to it and the next card starts clean. Machines busy on another Job Card are left alone.

fields.label: Look Ahead (days)
fields.description: Job Cards expected to start this many days ahead are listed; later ones are left out.

fields.label: Show Machine State on Workstations
fields.description: Whenever a machine changes state, queue its ERPNext Workstation's status to match (Running shows as Production, Down as Problem, Idle, Setup, and a lost signal as Off), which is what ERPNext's Plant Floor page shows. Needs Enable Postings and the machine's Workstation Reference.

fields.label: Post Downtime to ERPNext
fields.description: Queue every closed Downtime Record as an ERPNext Downtime Entry on the machine's Workstation, with the stop reason mapped from the Downtime Reason. A reason or note added later updates the entry. Needs Enable Postings.

fields.label: Downtime Operator (Employee ID)
fields.description: ERPNext requires an operator on every Downtime Entry. Entries FoaMES posts name this Employee (for example HR-EMP-00001) unless the posting carries its own.

fields.label: Post Maintenance Work Orders to ERPNext
fields.description: Queue every Maintenance Work Order that starts as an ERPNext Asset Repair on the machine's Asset (its Asset Reference), and bring the repair up to date when the work order completes or is cancelled. Needs Enable Postings.

fields.label: Submit Asset Repairs When Complete
fields.description: Submit the Asset Repair when its work order completes. Off, the completed repair stays a draft for a person to add costs and consumed items before submitting.

fields.label: Refresh Unresolved References Daily
fields.description: Look up External References that are Unverified or Missing once a day, in addition to the updates ERPNext document events trigger.
